title: Fantastic experience
text: We had Katia for the second time. She was very friendly & chatty. Katia was very knowledgable and hospitable. Ensuring our preferences were met. We went with another family & we all had a really lovely time & a good laugh. Would definitely recommend this tour. Thank you Katia for a lovely evening had by all 😊
author: Pinkxprincessx

title: Great Food Tour
text: My guide Katia hosted a great food tour! The food and wine was delicious and she did a great job explaining each item’s connection to the local cuisine. I attended as a solo traveler and had a wonderful time with the group!
author: ryanmL6023QU

title: A ‘must do’ if you visit Granada
text:
A wonderful, informative evening with Katia! 
We enjoyed great food & lovely wine.
Katia is extremely knowledgeable, teaching us about local history & traditions &, of course, wine & culinary delights!
A ‘must do’ evening if you visit Granada!
author: sageandonion25

title: Lovely experience in Granada!
text: Katia did a wonderful job educating us on the wines and history of Spain! We had a terrific time! The wine and food were superb! Very filling, plan on this being your dinner if you book! Highly recommend. We enjoyed visiting with the other travelers. The small group was nice!
author: shonal194

title: Knowledgable guide and fun times to be had
text: I had a lovely time with our guide Katia who has been in Granada for 25+ years and previously was associated with a top local restaurant.  We tasted 2 lovely olive oils that she brought including the acclaimed Hojiblanca from Rincon de la Subbetica.  I enjoyed a local Granada tinto  as well as 2 tintos de Ribuera del Duero and 2 tintos de Rioja.  The Costilla de Cerdo was wonderful at Casa Castaneda.  3.5 hours flew by.  I highly recommend.
author: sandeepk976

title: Great experience
text: Katia was full of interesting anecdotes and knowledge. The portions of wine and food were very generous and everything was delicious. We would recommend!
author: X9078SCireneg

title: Absolutely worth it!
text: The food and wine were delicious (and generous portions). Katia was a wonderful guide and very knowledgeable. She also emailed us photos from the evening, and even the recipe for one of the dishes we tried.
author: L777JNmarys

title: Super wonderful evening! Gracias Katia!!
text: This was the absolute highlight of the trip so far in Spain!  The wines (sublime!) N food pairings (one dish was a 10th century dish!)..and the knowledge Katia shares..about what actually goes into this level of quality..n some of the culture behind it..was really wonderful.  Thanks so much Katia that was such a lovely perfect evening! Xooo
author: farmwalkers

title: Much more than a wine tour
text: This was a fantastic and informative event. Katia is incredibly knowledgeable. Not only did we learn about wine, we also learned about olive oil and Spanish ham. I love that we can take this knowledge home as it will definitely change how I shop for oil and Spanish wine. The food was also excellent. So, be sure to show up hungry. We highly recommend this tour.
author: cynthiagM5075BO

title: Excellent wine and food tour
text:
It was a fabulous tour. Our guide Katia was very well informed and we really enjoyed the wines and food.
Thanks again Katia for a wonderful night.
Excellent tour!!!!
author: Jenny G
